architecture_summary: React Vite Tailwind app. Core: Vite for build, React for UI, Tailwind for styling. Pages: Home, Dashboard, Projects, Tasks, Reports, Settings. Components: reusable UI (cards, tables, modals, forms). State: local React state + context for global (auth, theme). Routing: React Router. API: fetch wrapper with error handling. Auth: JWT in httpOnly cookie. Dark mode: Tailwind class toggle. Responsive: mobile-first Tailwind.

tickets.title: Scaffold Vite React Tailwind project
tickets.description: Initialize Vite React project with Tailwind. Remove default Vite template files. Keep only index.html, src/App.jsx, src/main.jsx. Configure Tailwind for dark mode, mobile-first. Set up base Tailwind config (colors, fonts, spacing).
acceptance_criteria: Dark mode toggle works via class

tickets.title: Create Home page (src/pages/Home.jsx)
tickets.description: Build Home page matching Stitch UI. Components: hero banner, quick actions cards, recent projects list, call-to-action buttons. Use Tailwind for styling. Mock data for now. Ensure responsive layout.

tickets.title: Create Dashboard page (src/pages/Dashboard.jsx)
tickets.description: Build Dashboard page. Components: stats cards, project overview table, task progress chart (mock), recent activity feed. Use Tailwind for styling. Mock data for chart/table. Ensure responsive.

tickets.title: Create Projects page (src/pages/Projects.jsx)
tickets.description: Build Projects page. Components: project list table (sortable), create project modal, project cards grid. Use Tailwind for styling. Mock data for projects. Modal form validation (required fields).

tickets.title: Create Tasks page (src/pages/Tasks.jsx)
tickets.description: Build Tasks page. Components: task list table (filterable), task details drawer, create task form. Use Tailwind for styling. Mock data for tasks. Drawer opens from table row click. Form validation.

tickets.title: Create Reports page (src/pages/Reports.jsx)
tickets.description: Build Reports page. Components: report filters, charts (mock), export buttons. Use Tailwind for styling. Mock data for charts. Filters update chart data.

tickets.title: Create Settings page (src/pages/Settings.jsx)
tickets.description: Build Settings page. Components: profile section, theme toggle, notification preferences, account settings form. Use Tailwind for styling. Theme toggle persists to localStorage. Form validation.

tickets.title: Create reusable UI components (src/components/)
tickets.description: Build reusable components: Card, Table, Modal, Drawer, Button, Input, Select, DatePicker. Use Tailwind for styling. Ensure accessibility (keyboard nav, ARIA labels). Prop types for validation.

tickets.title: Create auth context (src/context/AuthContext.jsx)
tickets.description: Build auth context. State: user, token, loading, error. Methods: login, logout, checkAuth. JWT stored in httpOnly cookie. Context provider wraps app. Error handling for API calls.
acceptance_criteria: Auth check runs on app load

tickets.title: Create theme context (src/context/ThemeContext.jsx)
tickets.description: Build theme context. State: darkMode. Method: toggleTheme. Persists to localStorage. Context provider wraps app. Tailwind class toggle on root element.

tickets.title: Create API service (src/api/index.js)
tickets.description: Build fetch wrapper. Handles: auth headers, error responses, loading state. Methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE. Base URL from env. Error handling for 401/403 (redirect to login).

tickets.title: Create routing (src/routes/index.jsx)
tickets.description: Set up React Router. Routes: Home, Dashboard, Projects, Tasks, Reports, Settings, Login. Protected routes (redirect if unauthenticated). Layout component for shared UI (header, sidebar).
acceptance_criteria: Layout components render on all pages

tickets.title: App shell and navigation wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Wire up app shell. Import: auth context, theme context, router. Wrap app with providers. Set up global error boundary. Include global styles (Tailwind). Ensure all pages/components importable.
